Hi Alice  quick technical follow-up (turning the items Marissa listed into actionable details for your engineers).

SCIM / Provisioning:
- Protocol: SCIM 2.0; endpoints are /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups.
- Auth: OAuth2 bearer token per tenant (we provide scoped tokens).
- Supported attributes: userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work], externalId, active, roles (we map SCIM groups to RBAC roles).
- Provisioning modes: bulk import (CSV) -> SCIM sync -> IDP push.

SSO (SAML 2.0):
- SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows supported.
- Recommended NameID format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress.
- Metadata: we can provide SP metadata XML or manual config fields (ACS URL, EntityID, x509 cert).

RBAC / Admin controls:
- Role model: Owner (org-level, full admin), Admin (project-level config and user management), Editor (create/update resources), Viewer (read-only).
- Admin actions are logged and available in Audit logs (retention varies by plan; Dedicated includes 1 year by default).
- Self-service org creation can be restricted to invited domains / admin approvals.

Evidence / Docs:
- SAML diagram attached in Marissa's email.
- Full SCIM docs and API examples: https://redwood.app/share/iam-docs/ACME (link above).

If it helps, I can run a 30-minute technical call to walk your engineers through a sample SCIM sync and SSO setup  available Thu/Fri morning PST.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
